pw = None
for item in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords():
    if item['account_name']=='file_system':
        pw=item['password']
fs = apis.file_system.login(username='adrian_burt@gmail.com', password=pw)
access_token = fs['access_token']

spots = ['/home/adrian/pictures/vacations/bali/', '/home/adrian/pictures/vacations/maui/', '/home/adrian/pictures/vacations/santorini/', '/home/adrian/pictures/vacations/seoul/']

import os
results=[]
for d in spots:
    name=os.path.basename(os.path.normpath(d))
    zip_path=f'~/pictures/vacations/{name}.zip'
    res = apis.file_system.compress_directory(directory_path=d, access_token=access_token, compressed_file_path=zip_path, delete_directory=False, overwrite=False)
    print('compressed', d, '->', zip_path, res)
    results.append((d, zip_path, res))
print('done_compress_count', len(results))

pw = None
for item in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords():
    if item['account_name']=='file_system':
        pw=item['password']
fs = apis.file_system.login(username='adrian_burt@gmail.com', password=pw)
access_token = fs['access_token']

base_dirs = apis.file_system.show_directory(directory_path='~/pictures/vacations/', access_token=access_token, entry_type='directories', recursive=False)
print('base_vacations_subdirs_before', base_dirs)

deleted=[]
for d in base_dirs:
    exists = apis.file_system.directory_exists(directory_path=d, access_token=access_token)['exists']
    if not exists:
        print('skip_delete_nonexistent', d)
        continue
    resp = apis.file_system.delete_directory(directory_path=d, access_token=access_token)
    print('deleted', d, 'resp', resp)
    deleted.append(d)

remaining = apis.file_system.show_directory(directory_path='~/pictures/vacations/', access_token=access_token, entry_type='directories', recursive=False)
print('base_vacations_subdirs_after', remaining)
print('deleted_count', len(deleted))

pw=None
for item in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords():
    if item['account_name']=='file_system':
        pw=item['password']
fs=apis.file_system.login(username='adrian_burt@gmail.com', password=pw)
access_token=fs['access_token']

spots=['bali','maui','santorini','seoul']
zip_paths=[f'~/pictures/vacations/{s}.zip' for s in spots]
res=[]
for z in zip_paths:
    exists=apis.file_system.file_exists(file_path=z, access_token=access_token)['exists']
    res.append((z,exists))
print('zip_existence',res)

remaining=apis.file_system.show_directory(directory_path='~/pictures/vacations/', access_token=access_token, entry_type='directories', recursive=False)
print('remaining_vacation_subdirs',remaining)

# list top-level files in vacations dir
